But the README 'when not to use' is not honest: its 4th clause 'avoid when the per-case check is expensive and must be cached per component anyway, which is the situation the block lemma already encodes' is self-contradictory -- it warns against the move in exactly the per-component-caching situation the block lemmas provide (cfreducible.v L72 'hides the expensive reducibility evaluation'). It also diverges from entry.json avoid_when, whose 3rd clause ('per-case check not uniform enough for one generated tactic') is the honest converse and is missing from the README. Fix: replace that 4th README clause with the uniformity converse, or reword so expensive per-case checks read as a reason to use, not avoid.
